expectation: Nuclear stain in naive and stem-like memory T cells, plus a few NK and innate lymphoid cells. Should be fairly common in T-cell-rich areas: clustered in lymphoid aggregates and the stroma, a subset of CD3+ cells, and sparse in tumour epithelium.
observed: A: dense punctate cells gathered in lymphoid-rich regions in several images, with some yellow haze in a few tiles. B and C: sparse, with few positive cells. D: discrete small round nuclear-sized cells. E: TCF7 dots sit inside the CD3-dense area, with white and green on magenta.
why: Discrete nuclear-sized cells cluster in T-cell aggregates and sit on a subset of CD3+ cells, despite mild background haze in some images.
notes: TCF7 marks discrete small nuclei clustered in lymphoid and CD3-rich regions and overlapping CD3 in row E. Some images have a faint yellow background haze, but the cell-level pattern is specific.
